item.title: Mary Alice Renchin
item.description: Mary A. Renchin, 86, passed away on Sunday, March 22, 2026 at the Thorne Crest Care Center in Albert Lea, MN. A funeral service will be held at 11am on Friday, March 27, 2026 at the St. Theodore Catholic Church in Albert Lea.

item.title: Prosecutor: Elderly man suffered brain bleeds in alleged meat cleaver ...
item.description: A 44-year-old man is facing multiple charges after he reportedly critically injured an elderly man in what authorities have described as an unprovoked attack with a meat cleaver Saturday afternoon.

item.title: City Council approves 2 local cannabis registrations
item.description: The Albert Lea City Council voted 5-1 Monday to approve retail cannabis registrations for two local companies, bringing the number of approved dispensaries in the city up to four.

item.description: Medicare payment problems are generating steep financial hardships for some of Minnesota’s rural hospitals at a time when many are struggling to stay afloat.

item.title: Arnold "Arnie" Axel Skov
item.description: Arnold “Arnie” Axel Skov, age 89, passed away Saturday, March 21, 2026 at Good Samaritan Center in Albert Lea, MN. A visitation will be held from 4-7:00 pm Thursday, March 26, 2026 and will resume one hour prior (10-11:00 am) to the service on Friday at church.

item.title: Frances Wittrock
item.description: Frances passed away on January 17, 2026 at her apartment in Wells, MN. Frances was 94 years old. A celebration of life for Frances will be held on Aprill 11, 2026 from 1-4pm at the Nasinec Event Center, located at 789 Business Park Drive in Wells, MN.

item.title: House fire and other reports

item.title: Bryan David Skogheim
item.description: Bryan D. Skogheim, 46, of Albert Lea passed away peacefully on March 19, 2026, surrounded by his family after a courageous 18-month battle with cancer. A Memorial Service will be held at 11am on Saturday March 28, 2026, at Crossroads Evangelical Free Church in Albert Lea.

item.title: William "Bill" Nelson
item.description: William “Bill” Nelson, a beloved father, grandfather, and proud veteran, passed away on March 21, 2026, at the age of 81.
